lessons.trigger_condition: V400 could map V373 verified-outcome meta-neural action scores into the 18 tablet features and weakly learn later surface score changes, but it did not have a tablet-screen-specific neural model that directly maps current verified operational context into all 18 existing screen features.
lessons.prevention_rule: Use a separate device-local 17-input, 12-hidden, 18-output neural adapter. Train it only from previously applied allowlisted screen plans whose before/after surface scores both carry confidence at or above the verification threshold. Require the minimum verified row gate before inference, bound its per-feature bias, keep the final combined policy bias capped, persist the model only after upstream and capability gates remain allowed, and isolate model corruption to zero adapter bias.
validation_required: watched runtime changes are exactly tablet_autonomous_evolution_v400.py, tablet_autonomy_dashboard_v400.js, tablet_runtime_manifest.py, and tablet_screen_policy_neural_v401.py
screen neural architecture is exactly 17 inputs, 12 hidden units and 18 exact allowlisted feature outputs
screen neural inference is inactive below 12 verified training rows
training requires before and after surface confidence at or above 0.55
screen neural feature bias is capped at 0.05 and total combined screen policy bias remains capped at 0.08
screen neural model persistence occurs only after upstream and capability gates remain allowed
corrupt or unsafe model state produces zero screen-neural bias and does not overwrite the corrupt model
tablet runtime manifest includes tablet_screen_policy_neural_v401.py and final verification compiles the active runtime bundle
user clicks, pointer movement, browsing behavior and free-form user content are not training inputs
runtime source generation, source rewrite, arbitrary commands, Git/main writes, verification bypass and TCG fact invention remain forbidden
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: The dedicated screen neural adapter is a bounded advisory policy over the exact existing 18 feature keys. It cannot create UI/source code, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main, bypass verification, infer market direction, ingest user behavior, or fabricate card price, grade, stock, release or event facts.
